description: Read a post's video edit: the edit list the iPhone app renders (clips cut from takes on the phone, trims, speed, titles, captions, sound, looks, cover, hook versions), its rev, its length, each network's checks with a ready-made fix for edit_change, the render status and the captions as an SRT file. The phone records, edits and renders the video; the server only stores and checks this list. edit null: no edit yet, and the phone makes the first cut when the person opens the editor. lines numbers what's said in the edit, line by line, from the words the phone heard: choose cuts from them and change the edit by line number rather than typing times.

words.description: Each line's words with their times and i, for split before_word

name: edit_get
title: Get a post's video edit
